text:
Leah: heads up — noticed the new CRM connector sync created duplicate owner records for a subset of pilot accounts (happened during the backfill window). example account: acct_0x9b3f — two owner rows with different owner_ids. not good for healthscore and playbook routing.
Samir: ugh, thanks for spotting. any idea what triggered duplicates? logs or query to reproduce? :eyes:
Leah: looks like a race between the import worker and the owner-merger job. quick grep from the import logs:
```
[2026-03-18T09:12:02Z] import_worker INFO create_owner acct_0x9b3f owner_id=o_231
[2026-03-18T09:12:02Z] owner_merger WARN still_processing acct_0x9b3f
[2026-03-18T09:12:02Z] import_worker INFO create_owner acct_0x9b3f owner_id=o_529
```
Drew: ok that explains it. propose two immediate actions: 1) pause the nightly backfill for 1h, 2) run a dedupe job (idempotent) that merges owner rows and emits audit events. also we should add a short-lived playbook tag for affected accounts so CS doesn't get noisy alerts during the cleanup. example filter to find suspects:
```sql
SELECT account_id FROM owners GROUP BY account_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT owner_id) > 1 LIMIT 5000;
```
Anjali: +1 for pause + dedupe. For playbook automation, can we add a rule that tags accounts as "connector-dedupe-review" and routes them to the enablement queue, but suppresses healthscore alerts for 48h? want to avoid duplicate renewal nudges.
Drew: yeah here's a quick playbook rule snippet we can push as a dry-run:
```yaml
- name: connector-dedupe-review
  trigger: account.has_duplicate_owners == true
  actions:
    - tag: connector-dedupe-review
    - route: enablement-team
    - suppress_alerts: 48h
  mode: dry_run
```
Leah: perfect. can PlaybookBot schedule the dry-run and mark how many accounts would be affected? we'll only flip to active after CS confirm.
PlaybookBot: scheduled dry-run for rule "connector-dedupe-review" to run against last 30d of owners at 2026-03-18T15:30Z. estimated matches: 124. Report will be posted to #customer-success in 5m.
Samir: once we merge owners and tag them, we should recalc healthscore for those accounts (small batch). otherwise risk of false renewal-risk flags. I'll queue a healthscore recompute job for the 124 accounts after dedupe.
Anjali: also worth notifying the pilot customers' CSMs directly — small note in the account timeline explaining automated merge + manual review. Leah can you draft a short template?
Leah: will draft and post here in 10. suggested template: "We performed a hygiene fix to merge duplicate owner records created by the connector backfill. No action required — we've tagged the account for short review and suppressed automated renewal nudges while we validate."
Drew: thanks. timeline: pause now, dedupe in next 30m, dry-run playbook report in 5m, healthscore recompute after merge. tagging + CSM notes done by CS ops.
Leah: sounds good. assigning tasks: Samir -> dedupe job + healthscore recompute; Drew -> playbook dry-run + activate when CS approves; Anjali -> coordinate CSM notes; Leah -> post template + monitor.
Samir: on it. :thumbsup:
Anjali: thanks all. :heart:
Leah: closing loop once jobs succeed, will post final status here.
